Source: Coastal Post
Event: H1
Title: Harbour bridge closes

The harbour bridge will close for repairs from Monday, the port authority said. Dr. Meera Iyer, the chief engineer, said the steel cables had corroded faster than expected. Repairs are expected to cost Rs. 310 crore and take about eight months. “We cannot risk another monsoon on these cables,” Iyer told reporters. Ferry services will be doubled while the bridge is shut.

Source: Wire Service
Event: H1

Port officials announced that the harbour bridge closes on Monday for eight months of repairs. The corroded steel cables must be replaced, chief engineer Meera Iyer said. The repair bill is put at 310 crore rupees by the port authority. Extra ferries will run during the closure, officials said. Traders in the old market fear a drop in footfall during the closure.

Source: Wire Service
Event: H1

The harbour bridge shuts on Monday so that its corroded cables can be replaced. Engineers estimate the work will take eight months to finish. Ferry frequency on the harbour route will double from Monday. A U.S. firm, Lattice Corp., won the contract for the cable work. Commuters said the closure would add an hour to their daily journeys.

Source: Health Desk
Event: F1

Hospitals across the district reported a sharp rise in seasonal flu cases this week. Doctors at the general hospital said most patients were children under ten. The health department has asked schools to report absences daily. Free vaccination camps will open in twelve wards from Thursday.

Source: City Bulletin
Event: F1

Seasonal flu cases have risen sharply across district hospitals this week. Children under ten make up the majority of patients, doctors said. Vaccination camps offering free shots open in twelve wards on Thursday. Pharmacies reported shortages of paediatric fever syrup. Prof. Anil Rao said the peak was likely two weeks away.

Source: Arts Review
Event: O1

The youth orchestra performed Mahler's fifth symphony to a sold out auditorium on Saturday. Conductor Lina Duarte drew sustained applause after the final movement. Tickets for the autumn season go on sale next month.
unrelated: Volcanic ash grounded flights across northern airports overnight. Airlines cancelled dozens of departures until the plume drifts east.
Chess prodigy wins junior championship with a stunning queen sacrifice. Spectators applauded as the eleven year old shook hands with opponents.
Bakery chain launches sourdough subscriptions delivered weekly. Customers pick loaves online and collect them every Friday morning.
Glaciers in the valley retreated faster this decade, satellite surveys show. Researchers measured meltwater runoff using drones and buoys.
